### Healings in Gennesaret
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/healings-gennesaret
Passage: Mark 6:53-56
Points:
- The previous storm redirected the boat to Gennesaret, where locals immediately recognized Jesus.
- Seeing Him as their hope, the community carried their bedridden sick to wherever He went.
- Jesus wore the garment fringes required by the Mosaic law, showing His obedience to Scripture.
- Though their faith may have carried superstitious elements, it was effective because its object was Christ.
- Believers must not reduce Jesus to a miracle-worker, yet they can trust His power to heal and restore.
